```{r}
dat <- read.csv("NHL_2009_2018_combined_cleaned.csv",stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dat <- dat %>% arrange(Selection)
library(bnmr)
fit_GP <- bnmr(
    y = dat$GP_sum,
    x = dat$Selection,
    M = 20,
    niter = 3000,
    nburn = 1500,
    nthin = 1,
    direction = "decreasing",
    priors = list(mu0 = 0.5, phi0 = 20, intsd = 0.4715247)
  )

fit_TOI <- bnmr(
    y = dat$TOI_sum_min,
    x = dat$Selection,
    M = 20,
    niter = 3000,
    nburn = 1500,
    nthin = 1,
    direction = "decreasing",
    priors = list(mu0 = 0.5, phi0 = 20 , intsd = 0.6232552)
  )

fit_PS <- bnmr(
    y = dat$PS_sum,
    x = dat$Selection,
    M = 10,
    niter = 3000,
    nburn = 1500,
    nthin = 1,
    direction = "decreasing",
    priors = list(mu0 = 0.5, phi0 = 10, intsd = 3.0740209)
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

extract_scaled_curve <- function(fit, model_name, shift_if_negative = FALSE) {
  curve <- fit$fitted %>%
    dplyr::select(x, fitted) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Selection = x) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Selection) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(fitted = mean(fitted), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Selection)

  fitted_use <- curve$fitted

  if (shift_if_negative && min(fitted_use) < 0) {
    fitted_use <- fitted_use - min(fitted_use)
  }

  curve <- curve %>%
    mutate(
      fitted_adjusted = fitted_use,
      fitted_scaled = fitted_adjusted / sum(fitted_adjusted) * 1000,
      Model = model_name
    )

  return(curve)
}

curve_GP  <- extract_scaled_curve(fit_GP,  "GP")
curve_TOI <- extract_scaled_curve(fit_TOI, "TOI")
curve_PS  <- extract_scaled_curve(fit_PS,  "PS", shift_if_negative = TRUE)
curve_GAR <- extract_scaled_curve(fit_GAR, "GAR", shift_if_negative = TRUE)

all_curves <- bind_rows(curve_GP, curve_TOI, curve_PS, curve_GAR)

ggplot(all_curves, aes(x = Selection, y = fitted_scaled, color = Model)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  labs(
    title = "BNMR Fitted Curves Scaled to Sum = 1000",
    subtitle = "PS is shifted upward before scaling because fitted values can be negative",
    x = "Draft Selection",
    y = "Scaled fitted value",
    color = "Metric"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(bnmr)


dat <- read.csv("NHL_2009_2018_combined_cleaned.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(Selection)

dat2 <- read.csv("draft_pick_wide_GAR_adjusted_2009_2018_GARsum1_7.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(Year = DraftYr, Selection = DraftOv, GARsum) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Selection), !is.na(GARsum)) %>%
  arrange(Selection)

# 2. Helper function
#    - collapses duplicate fitted x values
#    - optionally shifts curve upward if negative
#    - scales fitted curve to sum 1000
#    - applies same transformation to observed y

make_panel_data <- function(fit, data, y_col, model_name, shift_if_negative = FALSE) {
  
  # fitted curve from bnmr output
  curve <- fit$fitted %>%
    dplyr::select(x, fitted) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Selection = x) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Selection) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(fitted = mean(fitted), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Selection)
  
  # observed data
  points <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(Selection, y = all_of(y_col)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Selection), !is.na(y)) %>%
    arrange(Selection)
  
  # transformation setup
  shift_value <- 0
  fitted_use <- curve$fitted
  
  if (shift_if_negative && min(fitted_use) < 0) {
    shift_value <- -min(fitted_use)
    fitted_use <- fitted_use + shift_value
  }
  
  scale_factor <- 1000 / sum(fitted_use)
  
  # transformed fitted curve
  curve_out <- curve %>%
    mutate(
      value = (fitted + shift_value) * scale_factor,
      Outcome = model_name,
      Type = "Fitted"
    ) %>%
    select(Selection, value, Outcome, Type)
  
  # transformed observed points
  points_out <- points %>%
    mutate(
      value = (y + shift_value) * scale_factor,
      Outcome = model_name,
      Type = "Observed"
    ) %>%
    select(Selection, value, Outcome, Type)
  
  list(curve = curve_out, points = points_out)
}


panel_GP  <- make_panel_data(fit_GP,  dat,  "GP_sum",      "GP")
panel_TOI <- make_panel_data(fit_TOI, dat,  "TOI_sum_min", "TOI")
panel_PS  <- make_panel_data(fit_PS,  dat,  "PS_sum",      "PS", shift_if_negative = TRUE)
panel_GAR <- make_panel_data(fit_GAR, dat2, "GARsum",      "GAR", shift_if_negative = TRUE)

curve_data <- bind_rows(
  panel_GP$curve,
  panel_TOI$curve,
  panel_PS$curve,
  panel_GAR$curve
)

point_data <- bind_rows(
  panel_GP$points,
  panel_TOI$points,
  panel_PS$points,
  panel_GAR$points
)


```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = point_data,
    aes(x = Selection, y = value),
    alpha = 0.45,
    size = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = curve_data,
    aes(x = Selection, y = value),
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Outcome, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "BNMR Fitted Draft Curves with Observed Data",
    subtitle = "Each fitted curve is scaled to sum to 1000; PS is shifted upward before scaling",
    x = "Draft Selection",
    y = "Scaled value"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
